methods_mapped.one_line: Tulu 3 supplies the open SFT/DPO/RLVR recipe to adapt only after Carnot's verifier-certification gate is clean.
Invisible Leash makes latent-vs-absent support the first gate before spending on RLVR or RFT.
RL-vs-distillation separates pass@1 accuracy lift from genuine capability expansion and external-knowledge injection.
Self-Distilled RLVR keeps verifier/environment reward as the update direction while using self-distillation for token credit magnitude.
STaR gives the minimal generate-filter-finetune rationale loop for verifier-certified traces.
ReST gives the offline generate-filter-improve cadence that fits Carnot's cached trace pools.
VPRM turns deterministic rule verifiers into dense process rewards instead of opaque neural step judges.
VPR extends dense verifiable process rewards to long-horizon agentic trajectories where sparse outcome rewards under-credit correct steps.
